name: Data sharing helps avoid "smoking gun" claims of topological milestones
problems: underwent a two-year peer and editorial review process after submission in September 2023, partly attributed by the authors to journals treating replication studies as lacking novelty
source_notes: S. M. Frolov et al. (Pittsburgh, Minnesota, Grenoble), Science (8 Jan 2026). Replication study of prior topological-milestone claims; several 'striking' signals admit non-topological explanations with full datasets. Calls for more data sharing.
